item.title: Data Models vs Data Abstractions
item.description: The landscape of programming is changing. Are your tools ready? As the days of vertically-scalable PC systems has come to an end (it's been awhile, but some still haven't noticed), the world of multicore, cloud computing, and mobile has taken over. Smart phones and social media have created an explosion of data volume, much of which is unstructured and in an ever-increasing variety of shapes and formats.It's all about the data...
